source_caption:
We are not gonna be friends. 🍸

This scene in The Wolf of Wall Street isn't just a romantic encounter; it’s a total shift in power. While Jordan Belfort (Played by Leonardo DiCaprio) is used to buying everything he desires, he finally meets the one thing he can’t manipulate: someone who sees right through him. Margot plays this with a lethal combination of charm and absolute coldness, turning a simple dinner into a psychological chess match. She wasn't just playing a "love interest" she was claiming her seat at the table and proving she could outmaneuver the most dangerous man in the room.
